    // The scale, rotation and translation the matrix is the product of, paired
    // with whether the extraction succeeded. Ported from System.Numerics: the
    // three linear rows give the scales; the rows are then visited longest-first,
    // each degenerate one (scale below 1e-4) rebuilt from a canonical axis or a
    // cross product so the basis stays complete; a negative determinant means a
    // mirrored basis, so the dominant axis and its scale are flipped. Extraction
    // fails — returning the identity rotation and `false` — when the repaired
    // basis is still not orthonormal (its determinant is not 1), which is what a
    // sheared matrix produces.
    // https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Polar_decomposition
    Decompose(self: Matrix4x4): Tuple4<Number3, Quaternion, Vector3D, Boolean> {
        var eps = 0.0001;
        var translation = Vector3D(self.Row4.X, self.Row4.Y, self.Row4.Z);
        var row1 = Vector3D(self.Row1.X, self.Row1.Y, self.Row1.Z);
        var row2 = Vector3D(self.Row2.X, self.Row2.Y, self.Row2.Z);
        var row3 = Vector3D(self.Row3.X, self.Row3.Y, self.Row3.Z);
        var scales = [row1.Length, row2.Length, row3.Length];
        var a = IndexOfLargest(scales[0], scales[1], scales[2]);
        var c = IndexOfSmallest(scales[0], scales[1], scales[2]);
        var b = 3 - a - c;
        var basis0 = [row1, row2, row3];
        // The dominant axis: a canonical axis stands in when the row has no length.
        var axisA = (scales[a] < eps ? CanonicalAxis(a) : basis0[a]).Normalize;
        var basis1 = basis0.ReplaceAxis(a, axisA);
        // The middle axis: crossed against whichever canonical axis is least
        // aligned with the dominant one, so the product cannot be degenerate.
        var axisB = (scales[b] < eps
            ? axisA.Cross(CanonicalAxis(IndexOfSmallest(axisA.X.Abs, axisA.Y.Abs, axisA.Z.Abs)))
            : basis1[b]).Normalize;
        var basis2 = basis1.ReplaceAxis(b, axisB);
        // The last axis is determined by the other two.
        var axisC = (scales[c] < eps ? axisA.Cross(axisB) : basis2[c]).Normalize;
        var basis3 = basis2.ReplaceAxis(c, axisC);
        var det = AxisMatrix(basis3[0], basis3[1], basis3[2]).Determinant;
        var mirrored = det < 0.0;
        var basis = mirrored ? basis3.ReplaceAxis(a, -basis3[a]) : basis3;
        var scale = mirrored ? scales.ReplaceElement(a, -scales[a]) : scales;
        var absDet = mirrored ? -det : det;
        var ok = (absDet - 1.0) * (absDet - 1.0) <= eps;
        var rotationMatrix = AxisMatrix(basis[0], basis[1], basis[2]);
        return (Number3(scale[0], scale[1], scale[2]),
                ok ? Quaternion.CreateFromRotationMatrix(rotationMatrix) : Quaternion.Identity,
                translation,
                ok);
    }
